observations.behavior: Adds 182 lines of tests, including parameterized checks for service tier, model-dependent tier assignment, and fallback behavior; also adds helper functions and mock setup.
observations.posthog_connection: These assertions check that the implementation correctly assigns request timeouts and tier settings, and that fallback behavior switches service tier and respects the activity budget. This could help prevent incorrect tier assignment or budget overruns in production, though the tests do not demonstrate actual runtime behavior or recovery. No score assigned.
